grounding.states: Messi is the soccer GOAT pick
grounding.from: Most recent coverage leans toward Lionel Messi as the GOAT

grounding.states: Messi has edged ahead in the GOAT debate after Qatar and the 2026 World Cup
grounding.from: Messi's performances in Qatar and at the 2026 World Cup have strengthened the view that he has edged ahead in the GOAT debate

grounding.states: Messi has eight Ballons d'Or, Ronaldo five
grounding.from: Messi has eight Ballons d'Or, compared to Ronaldo's five

grounding.states: Brady is still widely treated as the NFL GOAT

He has 7 Super Bowl wins (7-3 all-time)

grounding.states: Mahomes is the main challenger to Brady

value.answer: Messi, for soccer. He's pulled ahead in the debate after Qatar and his 2026 World Cup run, and he has eight Ballons d'Or to Ronaldo's five. Pelé still gets named, but Messi's my pick. If you mean NFL, it's Brady: 7 Super Bowl wins, with Mahomes the one chasing him.
